subject: Startups
title: The Decacorn Elite
description: A 60-second lesson on The Decacorn Elite.

hook.text: A decacorn is a startup valued at $10 billion or more. Only about 50 exist at any time. It's the startup 1% of the 1%.

buildup.text: Crossing $10B requires dominant market position, fast revenue growth, and usually a global customer base.

discovery.text: SpaceX, Stripe, ByteDance, and Databricks are decacorns. They operate in massive markets with high switching costs.

twist.text: Reaching decacorn status creates its own problem: the exit bar rises. Who can afford to buy a $30B company?

climax.text: Most decacorns must IPO because they're too large for an acquisition. The exit path narrows as valuation grows.

punchline.text: Grow too big and only the public market can buy you.

quiz.question: What is a decacorn?
options: A startup worth $10 billion or more
